script.title: LUNCH WITH A COWORKER
script.story_hook: Two coworkers plan a relaxed lunch break together.
script.intro_zh: 兩位同事一起規畫悠閒的午餐時間。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today we're inviting a coworker to lunch.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天我們來練習邀請同事一起吃午餐。
script.outro: That's it for today! Enjoy your next lunch.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！好好享受你的下一頓午餐。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's listen and repeat, one line at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一句一句來聆聽跟讀。

script.char_b_description: a heavyset man in his fifties with thinning gray hair and round glasses, wearing a soft white polo shirt and khaki trousers, checking his phone calendar with one hand while he nods
script.youtube_title: 【🥣約同事吃午餐】「你有空嗎」怎麼問最自然？🗓️時間・飲食偏好一次學✨｜Lunch Invite English
script.youtube_title_en: "Are You Free for Lunch?" — Inviting a Coworker
script.youtube_description:
想約同事吃午飯，卻不知道怎麼開口？這集用最輕鬆的辦公室對話，教你邀約、確認時間、詢問飲食偏好、決定要不要訂位。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完明天就能約同事一起去吃湯！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Want to ask a coworker for lunch but not sure how to start? This easy office conversation teaches you the invite, checking the time, asking about food preferences, and deciding whether to book a table. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, plus a repeat-after-me section so the phrases stick. Listen once and you'll be ready to ask tomorrow.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🥣約午餐英文｜詢問空檔・確認時間・飲食偏好｜聽完就會約同事｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
在辦公室想約同事吃飯，會不會不好意思開口？
約幾點才剛好？對方忌口該怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進週五中午的辦公室，跟著 Ana 從一句「are you free for lunch today?」開始，練習查看行程、約時間、詢問飲食偏好，最後開心地約好樓下見。

你會聽到：
🗓️ 相約與查行程：例如「Are you free for lunch today?」、「I have a call until twelve thirty.」。
🥗 飲食偏好：例如「Is it vegetarian friendly?」、「I don't eat red meat anymore.」。
📍 約時間與地點：例如「One works for me」、「I'll meet you downstairs at one?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把邀約句型唸成直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

明天中午，就換你開口約同事吧！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a takeout menu at a desk

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey Paulo, are you free for lunch today?
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ˈpaʊloʊ ɑr ju fri fər lʌntʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，保羅，你今天有空一起吃午餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me check my calendar first.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm lɛt mi tʃɛk maɪ ˈkæləndər fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，讓我先看一下我的行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wanted to try the new soup place.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwɑntɪd tə traɪ ðə nuː sʌp pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我想試試那家新開的湯品店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, the one near the park? Sounds good.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə wʌn nɪr ðə pɑrk saʊndz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 噢，公園附近那家？聽起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! What time works for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, I have a call until twelve thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ həv ə kɔl ənˈtɪl twɛlv ˈθɜrti/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我十二點半之前都有會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One works for me. Do they get busy?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wɜrks fər mi du ðeɪ ɡɛt ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 一點沒問題。那個時間他們人多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little, but we can just wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl bʌt wi kæn dʒʌs weɪt ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但我們稍等就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it vegetarian friendly, do you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˌvɛʤəˈtɛriən ˈfrɛndli du ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，他們有素食的選擇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They have salads and soups without meat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ hæv ˈsælədz ænd sups wɪˈðaʊt mit/
dialogue.zh: 他們有沙拉和不含肉的湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I don't eat red meat anymore.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ doʊnt it rɛd mit ˌɛniˈmɔr/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我現在不吃紅肉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, you'll love the chicken noodle one then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt jul lʌv ðə ˈtʃɪkən ˈnudəl wʌn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那這道雞肉麵湯你肯定喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool. Should we book a table or just go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kuːl ʃʊd wi bʊk ə ˈteɪbəl ɔr dʒʌs ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好。我們要先訂位還是直接去？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just go, it's walk-ins only, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌs ɡoʊ ɪts ˈwɔkɪnz ˈoʊnli aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 直接去就好，他們好像只收現場候位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll meet you downstairs at one?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl ˈmit ju ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz æt wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Bring your appetite, portions are huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs brɪŋ jɔr ˈæpəˌtaɪt ˈpɔrʃənz ɑr hjuʤ/
dialogue.zh: 對！把胃口帶來，他們的菜量超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for asking me along. See you at one!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ˈæskɪŋ mi əˈlɔŋ si ju ət wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你找我一起。一點見！
